title: How to Set the Passcode on the Orbital Strike Cannon
description:
I have been getting a lot of question about how to setup the passcode for the orbital strike cannon. And the trick is, ya don't, the cannon comes already configured with a working passcode. But if you wanted to learn more about how the passcode works and how to configure it yourself, then this is the video for you.
